title: Dessert Candle Workshop in Houston
includes: Guided dessert-candle decorating with piped wax swirls and wax toppings
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Make a candle that looks as sweet as it smells. This Dessert Candle Workshop combines custom fragrance, hands-on candle making and decorating with piping bags to create whipped-wax swirls and playful wax toppings.

Your instructor guides you through the process in a relaxed Houston studio, so beginners can enjoy creating their own dessert-inspired design. Come with friends, plan a creative date or make a scented keepsake for yourself. All candle-making materials are included, and you take home the candle you create.
